changelog:
Versi 1.5.3:
- Fix FileNotFoundException / IIOException saat menyimpan logo di Location Information, Parking Provider, Location Setting, dan Coupon di Windows
- Penambahan runtime Java Agent kompatibel lintas versi (parkee-win-compat-agent.jar) yang otomatis membuat subfolder induk sebelum ImageIO.write dan ImageIO.createImageOutputStream
- Auto-create subfolder imagesDirectory\location, imagesDirectory\PP, dan imagesDirectory\coupon di EnsureWindowsPatches
